# 00000006733

**TL3-03 ◆** — source: 210_代数表示论IV_倾斜理论II.md

**English.** Definition: The tilting class is the torsion-type structure generated by tilting modules. Conjecture: The finite-type criterion is given by the cotorsion pair and is complete, the verification of completeness being height one. (cotorsion finite-type criterion of tilting classes)

**中文。** 定义：倾斜类为倾斜模生成的挠型结构。猜想：有限型判据由余挠配对给出且判据完全；且完全性的验证为高度一层。（倾斜类有限型余挠判据）
